selection_rule.origin: Same frozen original G source-qualified identity population; original lineage may carry historic F support. No new F/expected_finite/G/amount/performance tests.
selection_rule.difference_disclosure: Prior full1297 identity list/producer was not saved; current strictly projected annual_basis/capture catalog/index reconstruction differs (1303/1298 versus prior1298/1297). Reason for full-pool count difference not fully established. No claim byte-identical recovery, and no values/eligibility/body read to force counts.
selection_rule.latest_rule: Choose unique latest publication date among ALL original G FY25 identities first; if chosen metadata/native index is pending do not fall back to an older easier version. Same-day competing identities remain pending. Later external editions/corrections remain unreviewed, not qualified.
selection_rule.duplicate_index_rule: All exact identity critical metadata signatures must agree; equal signatures collapse by stable source_index_key/path. Conflicting/missing signatures pending; no format preference.
selection_rule.native_compressed_bytes: Only selected80 gzip files stream SHA checked; never decompressed or original body read.

consumer_reuse.shared_read_case: Reuse bound capture/canonical/source_index/continuous native pages/EOF functions; source_index_ref from bindings.source_indices[case.source_index_binding_key].
consumer_reuse.pending_only_AR_adapter: Pure ar_structure.consume_pending_ar + unchanged f7b9 source_templates.table/tokens can be reused for AR-only source facts, with source-year/report metadata binding.
consumer_reuse.four_case_runner_reason: Existing consume_pending_ar.py hardcodes four previously diagnosed stock-empty cases and their receipts; new80 needs its own exact cohort/deadline/0context wrapper.
